integrity: The proof is analytic; finite SymPy checks supplement and do not certify the universal parameter range. Source dates refer to initial public arXiv versions.
scientific_limitations: The classification is exhaustive for paths with at most eight vertices, not for longer paths. Requires positive nearest-neighbour rates, no holding, geometric reset to the initial site, and absorption before reset. Earlier unindexed results and independent scrutiny remain possible limitations.
title: The sharp eight-vertex onset of interior geometric-reset splitting optima
